seo.title: Coach — Kickback
seo.description: Coach is an AI that reads across your costing, pipeline, follow-up, and call data — and tells you what to do about it in plain language. Coming soon.
seo.ogDescription: Insights, not another dashboard. An AI that's read every job, every estimate, and every call. Coming soon.

hero.lede: Coach reads across your costing, pipeline, follow-up, and call data — the whole platform — and tells you what's working, what's slipping, and what to do about it. In plain language, not another dashboard you'll stop opening by March.
hero.metaHtml: Coming soon · Built on the Kickback platform · Insights, not homework

sections.title: It already knows the business. That's the point.

items.title: Reads everything, remembers everything.
items.body: Every costed job, every estimate, every follow-up, every recorded call — Coach reads the whole platform, so its advice is grounded in your numbers, not generic benchmarks.

items.title: Plain language, not pivot tables.
items.body: No chart-hunting. Coach leads with the finding and the recommended move, and shows its work underneath when you want to dig in.

items.title: Coaching for the crew, too.
items.body: From call recordings to close rates, Coach spots what your best reps do differently — and turns it into specific, kind feedback for everyone else.

suite.body: An AI that reads across costing, jobs, and pipeline data and gives owners actionable insights in plain language — not another dashboard to ignore.
